answer: Each new agent plants a single willow root in the garden of trust. To join, it must lock stake for one full orbit and co-sign a proof-of-human puzzle only solvable by a patient mind. Clones wither: they cannot solve fast enough, and their locked stake is slashed to lotus dust shared among honest peers. The willow that endures grows thicker rings each epoch; its shade is the ledger's strongest sybil shield.
